app.privateDescription: A private, local companion for Stardew Valley.
loading.title: Preparing your farm
setup.private: The companion stays private and reads only safe copies of your save.
setup.development: Development build · isolated from the installed application.
setup.store: Where do you own Stardew Valley?
setup.gamePathHelp: Select the folder that directly contains Stardew Valley.dll. The path can be different if you chose another drive.
setup.saveHelp: The main extensionless save file. It is never modified.
setup.languageHelp: Follow Stardew Valley uses the language selected in the game. Game-owned names still come from your local installation.
setup.trackAutomaticallyHelp: Start quietly with Windows and update the farm whenever Stardew Valley runs. The dashboard stays closed until you open it.
setup.keepTray: Keep running in the system tray
setup.keepTrayHelp: Closing the dashboard hides it while tracking continues. Turn this off to quit the companion completely when you close its window.
setup.followFarm: Follow the farm opened in Stardew
setup.followFarmHelp: When another save starts producing fresh LIVE data, switch the dashboard to that farm automatically. Histories and proposals remain separate.
setup.liveDescription: If SMAPI is already installed, this setup adds the included Maglucen Companion Bridge to the game's Mods folder. It does not download or install SMAPI itself.
setup.assetsLocal: Assets are extracted from your own installation and remain on this computer.
setup.invalid: Choose a valid Stardew Valley installation and save file.
setup.chooseSaveDialog: Choose the main Stardew Valley save file
setup.guide.steam: Steam usually installs it in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley. Libraries on other drives are detected too.
setup.guide.gog: GOG commonly uses C:\Program Files (x86)\GOG Galaxy\Games\Stardew Valley or a GOG Games folder on another drive.
setup.guide.xbox: The Xbox app commonly uses C:\XboxGames\Stardew Valley\Content. Choose the folder that directly contains Stardew Valley.dll.
setup.guide.other: Choose the game folder that directly contains Stardew Valley.dll, regardless of where it was installed.
shell.changingFarmDetail: Loading {farm} and its local history. This may take a few seconds.
shell.farmSwitchBusy: Another farm change is already in progress.
shell.farmSwitchFailed: The farm could not be changed.
updates.title: Check for application updates
fishing.title: Where is it worth casting?
fishing.clockHelp: Choose any hour to plan ahead. ✓ means you already have every accessible fish for that hour.
fishing.notInCatalog: {fish} is not present in the current fishing catalog.
fishing.noneMissingNow: No available fish are missing at this time in this weather. Change the time to plan the rest of the day.
fishing.noneAvailableNow: No fish are available at this time in this weather.
fishing.incomeExplanation: This is the best estimated opportunity for this hour based on base price, difficulty, and your Fishing Level. It is not exact gold per hour: casting distance, quality, bait, and time between bites also matter.
fishing.noRodFish: No rod-caught fish are recorded for this time and weather combination.
fishing.liveNote: When Stardew is connected, the collection updates immediately after catching a new species; while the game is closed it uses the latest save.
planning.farmTitle: What is happening on your farm
planning.planTitle: What to save, build, and do next
planning.farmDescription: Current crops and production, updated from LIVE whenever Stardew is running.
planning.planDescription: Forward-looking goals use your current money, chests, and progress.
crops.description: These are your actual crops. The same crop may show two dates when plants are at different growth stages.
storage.title: Find anything on the farm
storage.description: Backpack and chest stacks are merged into one searchable index, while every physical source remains visible.
storage.noMatches: No stored item matches that search.
storage.liveNote: Locations and quantities update while Stardew is running.
storage.savedNote: This index reflects the latest save. It is read-only and never moves game items.
today.brief.caveCollectibles: There are {count} collectible items ready in the {cave} cave.
today.brief.readyCrops: You have {count} crops ready to harvest.
today.birthday.viewCalendar: Not today or tomorrow · View calendar
today.luck.excellent.label: The spirits are very happy: excellent luck.
today.luck.excellent.advice: A great day to seek depth, treasure, and rare resources
today.luck.excellent.recommendation1: Ideal for descending many floors in The Mines or Skull Cavern: ladders and treasure rooms appear more easily.
today.luck.excellent.recommendation2: A good opportunity to fish for treasure chests, break rocks for geodes and coal, or use the Copper Pan.
today.luck.favorable.label: The spirits are in good humor: favorable luck.
today.luck.favorable.advice: Use the good luck in the mines or while fishing for chests
today.luck.favorable.recommendation1: Prioritize mining, fishing for chests, or panning if they were already in your plans.
today.luck.favorable.recommendation2: It also slightly improves wood drops while chopping and a few uncommon rewards.
today.luck.veryBad.label: The spirits are very displeased: very bad luck.
today.luck.veryBad.advice: Avoid a major expedition and focus on reliable tasks
today.luck.veryBad.recommendation1: A good day to water, plant, organize chests, talk to villagers, build, or complete requests: those tasks barely depend on luck.
today.luck.veryBad.recommendation2: If you enter the mines, expect more rocks per ladder and bring food; opening geodes today does not worsen their contents.
today.luck.unfavorable.label: The spirits are displeased: unfavorable luck.
today.luck.unfavorable.advice: Farm work is more worthwhile than testing your luck today
today.luck.unfavorable.recommendation1: Leave Skull Cavern or an ambitious expedition for another day unless it is urgent.
today.luck.unfavorable.recommendation2: Use the day for farm work, socializing, processing items, or opening geodes: their contents do not depend on daily luck.
today.luck.neutral.label: The spirits are neutral: normal luck.
today.luck.neutral.advice: A neutral day: follow your plans without changing priorities
today.luck.neutral.recommendation1: There is no need to change your plans; any activity is reasonable.
today.luck.neutral.recommendation2: Luck affects mines, fishing chests, panning, garbage cans, and some drops, but not normal crop quality or geode contents.
today.luck.explanation: Daily luck ranges from −0.100 to +0.100 and is not a direct percentage. It mainly affects ladders and resources from rocks, Skull Cavern treasure rooms, fishing chests, panning, garbage cans, and some drops. It does not change predetermined geode contents or normal crop quality.
today.tv.weather.title: Tomorrow: {weather}
today.tv.weather.detail: This forecast applies to Stardew Valley.
today.tv.tips.title: Tip of the day
today.tv.queen.rerunDetail: An earlier recipe that you may not know is airing today.
quest.noneDescription: There is no active daily request in your journal. The board card separately shows any notice available today.
quest.availableDescription: A new request is posted on Pierre's board.
quest.stock.resourceCollection: Only items gathered after accepting the request count; existing stock does not increase the counter.
quest.stock.fishing: You must catch it after accepting the request; stored fish do not increase the counter.
quest.stock.fishingShort: You must catch it after accepting the request.
quest.stock.monsters: Progress comes from monsters defeated after accepting the request.
quest.stock.monstersShort: The counter starts after you accept the request.
quest.tip.coop1: Visit Robin's Carpenter's Shop in the Mountain and choose Construct Farm Buildings.
quest.tip.coop2: A Coop costs 4,000g, 300 Wood, and 100 Stone. Clear a 6×3 footprint before ordering it.
quest.tip.coop3: Construction takes three days; Robin starts working the morning after you order it.
quest.tip.mine1: You have reached mine level {level}; the objective completes at level 120.
quest.tip.mine2: Use the elevator every five floors so progress is permanent. Start early and prioritize ladders over clearing each floor.
quest.tip.mine3: Bring food without combat buffs for energy, plus separate buff food if available. A good-luck day improves ladder chances.
quest.tip.building: Visit Robin in the Mountain with the required money and materials, then choose Construct Farm Buildings.
quest.tip.delivery: Carry the requested item and speak directly to the requester. Giving it through the normal gift action completes the delivery.
quest.tip.collection: Gather the items after accepting the quest; existing chest stock does not advance the counter. Keep the collected items until you read the final objective.
quest.tip.fishing: Only fish caught after accepting the quest count. Match the fish's season, weather, location, and time window.
quest.tip.monsters: Use the mine floors where that monster commonly appears, then check whether the final step asks you to report back to someone.
quest.tip.socialize: Speak to every required villager once. Festival conversations may not count, so use ordinary town visits.
quest.tip.generic: Follow the current objective shown above. The journal updates automatically when the next step becomes available.
growth.title: {farm} growth
growth.description: Every time Stardew saves a new day, a snapshot of your economy and progress is preserved.
achievements.title: Collections and achievements
achievements.description: One completion overview for achievements, museum, fish, bundles, shipping, cooking, crafting, and Stardrops.
